positive: native plus exactly four frozen S_fit

negative.rule: existing hard_pool.select; nearest distance, input hash tie-break

RCAP_previous_bank: sequential RCAP accepted radii; trial candidate original radius

hazard.capture: new logical selection equals newly inserted expert
hazard.H_switch: previous active expert to newly inserted expert
hazard.ranking: descending each H separately; equal hazards share rank, insertion order display tie only
hazard.flag: nonempty capture triggers deterministic RCAP rule; no correctness-based threshold

unsafe_radius: mark UNSAFE_NO_RADIUS_SEPARATION; candidate with such entry is not deployment admissible; do not substitute router
unsupported_negative: mark UNSUPPORTED_NEGATIVE_PROTO; candidate is not deployment admissible; do not fabricate or silently fall back
CAL_SCOPE: side-track only; verified provenance required; no tuning this stage
single_RCAP: independent singleton insertion into empty bank using same frozen U_bg
